linear volume ramp from the current to the target volume over the given time, in 50 ms steps; at the end the same 0-stops rule as sound_set_volume

new object: +0x9d4 (children placed relative to it) = 1; starts at its parent's place (+0x9f8/+0x9fc) when the parent's +0x9d4 is set (findings audit 2026-10-18)
an object's x/y: numbers and @ added to its start place, Center/Middle/In*/Out* against the parent's rect when the parent's +0x9d4 is set, else the screen; +0x9ec/+0x9f0 = the parent's place
CreateWindow's worker: argument 6 (EAX) not `true` clears +0x9d4 and +0x9ec..+0x9f4, so the window's children are placed from the screen
deletes an object of the same name (00452d00), then creates it (0044c8c0)
Fade's worker: cb_Fade on each named object; the wait (ESI) `true` with time (EAX) > 0, or a number, waits
DrawTransition's worker: softness < 1001 or nothing; FUN_0044fe00 on each object, then the wait as Fade's
DrawTransition's step: loads the mask (FUN_00488130; none: returns, nothing drawn), threshold table ends from/to × 0.255, +0xc90 = 255 / softness
DrawTransition per frame: table 255 up to the eased threshold p, then −255/p × 255/softness a level, stored truncated (fldcw 0xc00 at 00457dee)
parse_texture_source into a new surface; 0 when the file is missing
frees a transition's mask and table, resets the object's draw callback
a camera's vertices: x = 512 + c·(X − 512)/Z, y about 288 (00489a52)
SetBlur on an object: on → FUN_00460230, off → +0xdb8 = 0
SetBlur trail: copies (≤ 128), interval (1..999), alpha; +0xdbc the `true` flag: trail drawn under the object (00454ca4), else over
SetPan: value × 10 (@ relative) clamped ±10000 → IDirectSoundBuffer::SetPan, or a fade thread
SetFrequency: base rate × value / 1000 (@ relative) → IDirectSoundBuffer::SetFrequency on any sound, or a fade thread
Conquest(file, label, set): the read marks of a scene; `true` marks it all read, null returns whether all is read (the skip's $AllRead)
runs one statement: dispatch_builtin, else (a letter or $ # ( + -) FUN_00472e50
reads a statement to `;` and evaluates it as an expression: a call of no built-in and no NSS function does nothing
advances an effect's 16.16 step index by (now - the object's last frame stamp 0x9b4) ms / 16 (ms a frame, init_frame_tables): count = floor(time*60/1000) steps last 16*count ms
the script thread's wait for a waited effect: polls the named objects every 16 ms until their step callbacks are idle
one render pass: per object, stamps timeGetTime before its callbacks and stores it in 0x9b4 after
draws and presents when something changed, else sleeps 16 ms
